name: Omavoice
author: Slava Baranskyi
description: Talk to your local agent out loud. Vosk hears you, a Hermes gateway agent finds the answer, edge-tts speaks it back — all local, no cloud voice API.

barWidget.description: Voice assistant with access to this machine

schema.label: Local agent
schema.description: Who finds the answer: hermes is the local gateway agent (default); ollama is a local LLM on this machine (qwen2.5:3b, no cloud at all); codex and claude remain available if installed.

schema.label: Show state as text
schema.description: One word next to the icon: listening, looking, speaking. Lets you talk to the assistant without opening the panel.
